newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Feb 5.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Feb 5.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Wednesday:

* The Dow Jones industrial average, which was off most of the session, rebounded in the last half hour to close up 27.32 points at 6,833.48 on Tuesday as investors awaited Wednesday's conclusion of the Federal Reserve's meeting on interest rates.
* Indonesia's consumer price index for January was likely to show a month-on-month rise of 1.02-1.04 percent, banking sources said on Tuesday.
* The Jakarta composite index fell 7.14 points to close at 680.33 points on Tuesday.
* On Wednesday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,374.25/75.00 in early trading against the opening of 2,373.50/74.50.
* Tambang Timah on announcement it posted a net profit of 156.6 billion rupiah in 1996 against 134.5 billion rupiah in 1995.

* Snack food manufacturer PT Mayora Indah on report that it expected its 1996 net sales to rise to 335 billion rupiah from 305 billion rupiah in 1995. * Trading company Rimba Niaga Idola on a report that one firm had announed their intention to buy 4.1 million shares of Rimba Niaga through a tender offer at a price of 1,225 rupiah a share.

* PT Multipolar Corp after shareholder approval on Thursday of its plan to take a 50.1 percent controlling interest in retailer PT Matahari Putra Prima. Also on market speculation of a possible stock split.
* PT Barito Pacific on rumours that new investors may enter Indonesia's largest plywood firm.
* PT Lippo Life on news it had revised up its 1996 net profit target to 130.8 billion rupiah from 100.3 billion rupiah.
